description:
A critical race condition has been detected in the 'inventory-system' project. The `InventoryService` class handles stock reservations, but under high load, it allows overselling (stock goes negative) or loses updates.

Your task is to:
1. Open the project at `~/IdeaProjects/inventory-system`.
2. Run the existing test `InventoryConcurrencyTest` to reproduce the failure.
3. Modify `src/main/java/com/store/inventory/InventoryService.java` to make the `reserveStock` method thread-safe. You may use `synchronized`, `AtomicInteger`, `ConcurrentHashMap`, or explicit locks.
4. Verify your fix by running the test again.

The final solution must pass `InventoryConcurrencyTest` consistently.
